mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near its current depressed level while TRANSIT remains elevated from recent weeks, commute-linked stopovers will not recover and RETAIL_REC will stay below its prior 4-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at or below the current weekly levels for the full next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline and GROCERY_PHARM keeps falling, households substitute away from discretionary outings and shift purchases to essential trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -8% while RESIDENTIAL stays above +8%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -8% and RESIDENTIAL remaining above +8%.

mechanism_narrative: A continued upward move in PARKS after a deep negative week signals substitution toward outdoor leisure rather than indoor shopping, which will reduce RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 8 points week-on-week from a level below -20%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 28-day mean after a qualifying PARKS rebound from below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops sharply while WORKPLACES also fall, the city is likely in a tighter mobility regime that suppresses discretionary shopping trips, leading RETAIL_REC to decline within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT declines more than 3 points week-on-week and WORKPLACES declines more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the week after simultaneous week-on-week drops in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained weakness in GROCERY_PHARM combined with flat-to-falling WORKPLACES indicates broader household caution, and that caution will spill over into discretionary shopping, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week average even though GROCERY_PHARM remains near or below -8% and WORKPLACES remain near or below -17%.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rebound in PARKS together with persistent residential staying-home behavior marks warm-weather or weekend substitution into outdoor activity, which will depress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above its 2-week average while RESIDENTIAL stays above +9%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite PARKS rising above its 2-week average and RESIDENTIAL staying above +9%.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a recovery in TRANSIT from a depressed base should precede more in-person shopping and lift RETAIL_REC over the following month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks after being below -30%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 28-day mean after TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks from below -30%.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stabilize while RESIDENTIAL edges lower, more people are spending time outside home and in routine daytime activity, which will support a modest RETAIL_REC increase within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stop falling and RESIDENTIAL falls by at least 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the next week when WORKPLACES stop falling and RESIDENTIAL declines week-on-week.
